tasks.title: Keep the PMO floating panel on an explicit Demand target
tasks.objective: Prevent the PMO floating surface from selecting an older PMO Session while a Demand-specific Agent is attaching.
tasks.outcome: The panel treats an explicit target Tab as authoritative until its Agent is visible, while untargeted PMO opens retain their existing behavior.
acceptance: Targeted PMO opening waits when the target Tab is still a launcher and never falls back to another PMO Session.
Targeted PMO opening focuses the target Agent once its Session is attached and only then clears the transient target.
Untargeted PMO opening continues to focus an available PMO Session.
The regression test fails when target preference or target waiting is removed.

verification.ref: CI=true pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/demand-pmo-tab-context.test.ts test/pmo-teams-topic-floating.test.tsx test/pmo-teams-topic-floating-contract.test.ts test/pmo-floating-target-isolation.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && CI=true pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop typecheck
verification.proves: Demand target routing, floating target waiting, direct PMO fallback, and renderer type safety
